mapRecords.note: A map showing the terrain of the surrounding countryside.  It pinpoints the locations of towns, outposts and citadels.
Scribbled on the map in dwarven runes are the words "abandoned vault".  An X marks the location of a secret cavern.
The footman's map showing the location of the Glowing Coal Inn.
A map of the gnaths stronghold's upper floor.  A ogre has marked the room where the gnath leader spends most of his time.  The outer room is constantly patrolled by his best troops.
Cave rumored to exist in the Imhotep Gap.
A map showing the location of a great battle between King Bradwick's men and some gnath.
A map showing the location of some vermin that are supposedly located in a cave near wispy falls.  Village elders have asked you to blow a magical ivory horn which provokes an attack.
A map showing the location of an old man you have been hired to assassinate.

A map given to you by an old dwarf.  It shows the location of a mysterious island.  This island may lead to a dwarven clan who have withdrawn from the rest of the Realmz.  Scribbled on the corner of the map are the words, "Flying Potion Needed".
A map showing the location of a small cave that leads into the ice giant compound.
A map showing the location of a small tunnel created by Anti'ids.  The Anti'ids were making plans to capture giants for use as psionic brain food.
This map shows the location of an entrance that can only be used with the aid of a magical necklace.
A map showing the location of a hinge pin that was to be pulled in case the citadel had to be abandoned.  Pulling this pin will cause the entire citadel to collapse.
A map showing the location of a secret passage to a laboratory.
A map you found on a dead gnath.  You can't read any of the words written on the dirty scrap of papyrus.  You can only make out an X scribbled with a piece of charcoal.
A page containing a sketch that you found on a Anti'ids body.
